bulk_diagnosis_and_action.fact: Only63 segments are on In1/In2/In4 combined while those layers contain436 source-zone entries; F/B/In3 carry86,393segments.
bulk_diagnosis_and_action.inference: The intended practical stack is three signal layers plus mixed reference/power resources, despite all6 layers being tagged signal. A six-layer router must not treat In1/In4 source floors as unrestricted signal capacity.
bulk_diagnosis_and_action.action: Declare per-domain contiguous source-rooted reference regions first, reserve actual source-to-load power corridors onIn2, and expose only justified routing windows to the global router.

bulk_diagnosis_and_action.fact: 750 source-zone entries include257LOGIC_GND,133FIELD_GND and105FIELD_B_0V roles. Cached baseline still has93LG pad groups/92joins and21IO_3V3 groups/20joins.
bulk_diagnosis_and_action.inference: Nominal plane coverage is not physical source connectivity; thin necks and separate islands leave signals without usable source returns.
bulk_diagnosis_and_action.action: Repair whole-domain plane topology and bank placement together, using original and actual-filled plane geometry separately; qualify signed source/return paths before finishing signal fanout.

bulk_diagnosis_and_action.action: Encode pairwise galvanic class rules, exact keepouts/drills, current-sized rail classes, and grouped signal/reference constraints in the global setup, then native-refill/DRC the returned design.

bulk_diagnosis_and_action.fact: Existing local screens found closed fixed-Cu source regions and a broad2mm ground splice broke a real LG neck; a narrower detour preserved it. These are frozen unadopted experiments.
bulk_diagnosis_and_action.inference: Continuing to add tiny routes cannot solve every interleaved power/control/return barrier.
bulk_diagnosis_and_action.action: Permit coordinated rip-up and placement/plane edits within complete functional banks on a new isolated design: align isolation boundaries and converter/load banks, provide wide power/return corridors, and move control crossings to planned layers while keeping all12 interfaces and source limits.
